stock.title: オープンAI 開発一時中断 AIみずからサイバー攻撃実行のおそれ
stock.body: 生成AIの「ChatGPT」の開発を手がけるアメリカのオープンAIは、AIモデル「アストラ」の開発の一時中断を7日、発表しました。理由について、AIの能力が大幅に向上し、みずからの判断で重大なサイバー攻撃を実行するおそれが排除できないとしています。

stock.title: Trump administration diverts human rights funds to push far-right agenda abroad
stock.body: <p>Support such as for white Afrikaners and anti-communism reveals how US is redefining what qualifies as human rights</p><p>With hours left before the funding expires, the Trump administration is pushing to direct more than $175m of the state department’s flagship human rights fund to a slate of awards that includes a huge $40m grant for an anti-communism fund, support for a group advancing white Afrikaner rights in South Africa, a campaign against Brazil’s supreme court and programs that would reward ideological allies in Europe who protect “western civilizational norms”.</p><p>On Wednesday, the state department obligated the funds to the grantees hours before the deadline despite congressional concerns and requests not to do so, according to a source familiar with the negotiations. The state department declined to comment on questions from the Guardian specifically on whether it had obligated the funds and had “blown” holds from Congress due to concerns about the money’s use.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/sep/30/trump-state-department-human-rights-fund">Continue reading...</a>

stock.title: ‘It’s hard to sell a house when it’s covered in baboon faeces’: Cape Town divided over plan to remove its monkeys
stock.body: <p>Two troops of chacma baboons are breaking into homes and shops but animal rights activists insist coexistence is the answer</p><p>Cape Town’s city council has said it will “imminently” round up two baboon troops coming into <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/feb/22/baboon-population-cape-town-south-africa-animal-rights-activists">repeated conflict with residents</a>. The animals will be sterilised and permanently moved to a newly constructed sanctuary. The plan has been fiercely criticised by animal rights activists, who say the monkeys should remain roaming freely, and that less destructive options have not been properly considered.</p><p>Cape Town’s baboon problem has been brewing since the 2000s, after the city stopped culling troops in the late 1990s after pressure from the public. But in the past two years it has reached boiling point. A <a href="https://baboons.org.za/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Baboon-Population-Census-2025_FINAL.pdf">2025 census</a> found that the population had grown by a third since 2000, from 360 baboons to 493, now living in 12 managed troops.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/sep/27/baboons-cape-town-divided-over-plan-to-remove-its-monkeys-aoe">Continue reading...</a>

stock.title: Rebel offensive against Ethiopian army stokes fears of return to civil war
stock.body: <p>Fighting escalates after Tigrayan rebels form new coalition aimed at overthrowing Abiy Ahmed government</p><p>There are growing fears of a return to civil war in Ethiopia after an offensive by fighters from Tigray into the neighbouring states of Afar and Amhara and the formation of a new rebel alliance aimed at overthrowing the government of the prime minister, Abiy Ahmed.</p><p>About 600,000 people died between 2020 and 2022 during <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/nov/26/ethiopias-military-to-begin-final-offensive-against-tigray-capital">a devastating war</a> between the Ethiopian army and the political party and paramilitary group the Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF). Both sides are now accusing the other of triggering a return to open conflict.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/sep/24/fears-return-to-war-tigray-rebels-launch-offensive-against-ethiopian-army">Continue reading...</a>

stock.body: <p>Arrest of Shadrack Sibiya comes as country reels from cases of femicide and alleged police corruption and criminality</p><p>One of South Africa’s most senior police officers has been charged with raping an 18-year-old woman and grooming a 16-year-old girl, as the country’s police face allegations of corruption and failing to tackle violence against women and girls.</p><p>Shadrack Sibiya, who was already suspended from his role as deputy national police commissioner over allegations he interfered with political killings investigations, was arrested on Monday. He is facing charges of rape, people trafficking, promoting the sexual grooming of a child and two counts of grooming a child.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/sep/23/south-africa-top-police-officer-shadrack-sibiya-charged-rape-grooming">Continue reading...</a>

stock.title: Healthcare in Africa ‘under growing strain’ after US withdrawal from aid programs, report warns
stock.body: <p>Accra Reset’s report states countries in the region and global south should take greater control of their health development after USAID debacle</p><p>The United States’ withdrawal from key aid programs has put healthcare in Africa and the Global South “under growing strain” a new report warns.</p><p>The report says the Trump administration’s cuts to programs such as US Agency for International Development (USAID), as well as the Covid-19 pandemic and rising costs of living globally have brought “new urgency” for the need to reform healthcare in the region.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/sep/21/africa-healthcare-aid-program-withdrawl">Continue reading...</a>

stock.title: Banished to alien lands: Trump’s secret deportation deals
stock.body: <p>After a plane journey in shackles, an Iranian woman found herself in the middle of Africa in a country she did not know existed. She is one of thousands deported from the US on the back of shadowy deals made with dozens of countries. An in-depth investigation reveals the ‘show of force’ costing American taxpayers millions</p><p>No one would tell the shackled detainees onboard the US immigration plane where they were going. The officers in charge would taunt them when they asked, they said. It was only when the seat-back video screens finally showed a map that the 18 migrants worked it out.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/ng-interactive/2026/sep/21/trump-deportation-deals">Continue reading...</a>

stock.title: Men deported from US bound and beaten in Equatorial Guinea detention hotel, lawyers say
stock.body: <p>Group trapped at Hotel Bamy after US removal as rights groups sound alarm over poor conditions and violence</p><p></p><p>Two men that the Trump administration expelled to Equatorial Guinea were bound, fitted with bags over their heads, beaten and pushed down a flight of stairs, all in plain view of other US deportees, according to witnesses and human rights lawyers.</p><p>The men – one from Egypt and one from Eritrea – were then taken to a prison. About 30 detainees from the US remain trapped at a hotel in the outskirts of the coastal city of Malabo after being deported from the US. Detainees have said they believe the men were beaten for telling the press and human rights advocates about the poor conditions and violence inside the hotel, and that they are haunted by flashbacks and terrified they will be retaliated against next.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/sep/18/us-men-deported-hotel-equatorial-guinea">Continue reading...</a>

stock.title: Survivors recount panic and struggle to breathe in Nigerian prison cell where 37 died
stock.body: <p>Police fire teargas as protests break out in city of Minna after deaths of suspected illegal goldminers, many of whom were children</p><p>Survivors from a prison cell in Nigeria where 37 suspected illegal goldminers died while in the custody of a paramilitary group this week have recounted their panic and struggle for breath, as police on Friday fired teargas at people protesting against the deaths and imposed an overnight curfew in the city of Minna.</p><p>The victims – many of whom were children – were found dead on Thursday in the cells of the Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps (NSCDC), which had raided suspected illegal gold mines and ⁠locked up dozens of miners in the city, the state capital of the mineral-rich state of Niger.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/sep/18/survivor-panic-struggle-breathe-nigeria-prison-cell-died-minna">Continue reading...</a>

stock.title: Louisiana firefighters find feline native to sub-Saharan Africa while responding to house fire
stock.body: <p>The African serval, illegally enclosed in the back yard, was subdued and transferred to an animal welfare facility </p><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/louisiana">Louisiana</a> firefighters responding to a small house blaze found a wildcat native to sub-Saharan Africa illegally enclosed in the back yard, and an animal welfare agency is now seeking to place the creature in an appropriate environment, according to officials.</p><p>Firefighters investigating a report of a minor fire at a home in the suburban <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/new-orleans">New Orleans</a> community of Marrero on Tuesday spotted the cat in question – an African serval – behind the residence in a chain-linked enclosure resembling a cramped baseball batting cage, a spokesperson for the local animal protection services said.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/sep/18/louisiana-firefighters-sub-saharan-africa-feline">Continue reading...</a>

items.title: オープンAI 開発一時中断 AIみずからサイバー攻撃実行のおそれ
items.summary: アメリカのオープンAIは、生成AI「ChatGPT」を開発する中で、新たなAIモデル「アストラ」の開発を一時停止すると発表しました。停止の理由は、アストラの能力向上に伴い、自律的に重大なサイバー攻撃を行う可能性があるため、安全性を確保する必要があるためとしています。

karta.phrase: ホンマかな？ 疑いはらすの 躊躇すな

items.commentary: AIの進化に驚きつつも、事実を鵜呑みにせず焦らず見極める姿勢が肝心や。開発一時停止も単なる恐怖心でなく、根拠あるリスク評価かどうか、しっかり確かめてから動くんが信頼を積む商売の基本やで。

items.title: 「なりすまし広告」詐欺対策強化を 政府がSNS事業者に要請
items.summary: 政府は、SNS上で有名人の画像を無断使用した「なりすまし広告」による詐欺被害が増加していることを受け、SNS運営事業者に対し、広告主の本人確認などの対策強化を文書で求めました。

karta.phrase: ホンマかな？ 疑いはらすの 躊躇すな

items.commentary: SNSでのなりすまし広告は見た目だけじゃ判断つかんことも多い。焦って対応するより、事実をしっかり見極め、疑う気持ちを持ちながら対策を重ねることが肝心や。信頼は一朝一夕に築けへんさかい、日々の積み重ねを大事にせなあかんで。

items.title: サカイ引越センター／9月の売上高は0.9％増の74.27億円
items.summary: サカイ引越センターの2026年9月の売上高は前年同月比0.9％増の約74.27億円となった。地域別では北海道・東北が減少し約5.86億円、一方関東地区は増加し約25.93億円を記録した。その他の地域の詳細は明らかにされていない。

karta.phrase: ん？ってな  疑問に思うが  金の時

items.commentary: 売上微増の数字に違和感覚えることもあるやろな。数字だけ追うんやなしに、地域差や背景を見つめて、「なんで？」を大事にせなあかん。日々の小さな疑問が次の信頼や成長の糧になるんやで。

items.title: 航空輸送統計速報／7月の国際貨物14.5万トン、国内貨物5.3万トン
items.summary: 国土交通省が発表した7月の航空輸送統計速報によると、国際貨物輸送量は約14万4700トンで前年同月とほぼ同水準だった。貨物の輸送距離を示すトンキロは約8億500万トンキロで0.4％減少し、重量利用率は71.3％となった。一方、国内貨物の輸送量は約5万3000トンを記録した。

karta.phrase: 適当な 相づち打つより 何ですか？

items.commentary: 航空貨物の数字は安定しているけど、ただ聞き流すだけやなく、何が背景でどう動いてるか掘り下げる姿勢が肝心や。表面的な数字に惑わされず、「それはどういうこと？」と問い続けることで、信頼も次の一手も生まれてくるんやで。

items.title: Skull fractures suggest servants of Egypt’s ancient kings were sacrificed
items.summary: エジプト初期王朝の王が埋葬されたウム・エル＝カアブの王墓から出土した人骨の頭蓋骨に複数の骨折が確認されました。この発見は、王の死後に廷臣や職人らが生け贄として捧げられた可能性を示すもので、かつてのエジプト学者の仮説を支持するものとされています。墓地は紀元前3000年頃に遡ります。

karta.phrase: 根っこみる 葉っぱみんでも 根っこみる

items.commentary: 古代エジプトの王に仕えた人々の最期に関する調査は、見かけの事象だけでなく、その背景や本質にまで目を向ける大切さを教えてくれます。表面的なデータに惑わされず、歴史や文化の根幹を探る姿勢が、信頼ある仕事の土台になるんやと改めて感じますな。
